### Mercy Amidst Judgment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/mercy-amidst-judgment
Passage: Jeremiah 4:27
Points:
- Jeremiah shifts abruptly from offers of pardon to a vision of inescapable devastation.
- God foresaw that the majority of Judah's populace would refuse to repent.
- Amid the grim prospect of complete ruin, the Lord promises not to make a full end.
- Divine judgment preserves a faithful remnant rather than granting universal exemption.
- Believers share in that promised preservation by grace alone through repentant faith.
